Package mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character

Class Player

java.lang.Object
mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character.Character
mpl1.thelastguest.model.Character.Player
public class Player extends Character
Represents the player character.

The Player inherits all core functionality from Character and adds player-specific behavior such as perception checks and inspector status.

    • isPerceptible

      public boolean isPerceptible(int posX, int posY)
      Determines whether a position on the map is perceptible by the player. A position is perceptible if it falls within the player's perception range, determined by the player's PER stat.
      Overrides:
      isPerceptible in class Character
      Parameters:
      posX - X coordinate to check
      posY - Y coordinate to check
      Returns:
      true if the position is within perception range, false otherwise
